result.planSummary: Resolved verifier finding S5-001 only. In src/cli/view.ts, `view pull` now prints the message array itself as JSON on stdout on success (the AC-5.5/TC-5.4 contract: the array IS the product, not an OpResult envelope), and `view materialize` prints the written path itself on stdout. Both commands fall through to the existing renderResult on failure, so every failure case still exits nonzero with the structured OpResult error JSON (missing-thread and unknown-format legs unchanged and still passing). status, compact, and sweep are untouched and keep printing the SDK result JSON, preserving their parity coverage. The --help blurb names the two success-output exceptions. cli-process-view.test.ts now asserts the story contract directly: the pull parity leg and the CLI-advance leg parse stdout as a ViewMessage[] and compare it to the SDK pull's messages; the materialize leg asserts stdout.trim() equals the --out path before validating the file. Manifest hash re-recorded for the modified process test; both gates rerun green.

findingsFixed: S5-001: view pull and view materialize success output now match the story contract (top-level message array / bare written path) at the spawned-process boundary, asserted directly without OpResult unwrapping
findingsSurfaced: Pull emits the array on success with or without --json (the flag remains a grammar-compatible no-op since JSON is the only output shape); the pull's ViewMeta no longer crosses the CLI on success — operators read those numbers via view status, and failures still carry the full structured error

Failure-case output is deliberately asymmetric with success output for these two commands (structured OpResult JSON on exit 1) — this is the story's own requirement ('failure case exits nonzero with a structured error') and is covered by the missing-thread and unknown-format legs
